Metadata.title: Astral Tech Gaming — Custom gaming PCs & parts
Metadata.description: Custom gaming PCs built by hand in Toronto and Montreal, plus the parts to build your own.

Home.title: Custom gaming PCs, built by hand.
Home.lead: Pick your parts or let us spec it for you. We assemble, install Windows, test every build and hand it to you in person.
Home.comingSoon: The online store is open. The PC builder is coming soon.
Home.videoLabel: Video of a finished white Astral Tech Gaming build with ice-blue lighting
Home.buildsLead: Every PC is assembled, cable-managed and tested before it leaves our bench.

buildAlt.1: White dual-chamber case with an MSI GeForce RTX graphics card and an AIO cooler with a pixel-art display
buildAlt.2: White build with a Gigabyte GeForce RTX graphics card, T-Force memory and a status screen showing temperatures
buildAlt.3: Close-up of a white build with three top radiator fans and an MSI GeForce RTX graphics card
buildAlt.4: Close-up of the AIO pump display, white memory modules and an M.2 SSD
buildAlt.5: Close-up of an MSI GeForce RTX graphics card with its power connector

choose.title: Choose your parts
choose.body: Use the PC builder to pick compatible parts, or start from one of our builds.

build.title: We build it
build.body: About an hour of careful assembly, Windows installed, then testing.

handoff.title: Pickup or delivery
handoff.body: Collect it in Toronto or Montreal, or we deliver it to you in person.
